plugins.name: ship-armada
plugins.description: Portfolio-wide orchestrator across every project in ~/Dev — the layer above ship-fleet, and the system prompt for a standing master-orchestrator agent/daemon. Reads the portfolio manifest (~/Dev/ARMADA.md) and ~/Dev/CLAUDE.md, verifies freshness against git, then surveys, plans, routes, and dispatches. Route mode lands a single directive ('research feature X and incorporate it into <project>') in the right project's pipeline — deep research into docs/deep-research, a brief into features-to-triage, an inbox row in the project's ORCHESTRATOR.md that any active fleet picks up (or a new ship-fleet run when approved), and the master manifest updated. Dispatch runs per-repo backlogs through ship-fleet and cross-project rollouts as dependency-ordered campaigns with capped concurrency. Daemon mode proposes on a schedule and executes only what the user has approved.

plugins.name: armada-sync
plugins.description: Keep the portfolio manifest ~/Dev/ARMADA.md truthful after working in any ~/Dev project. Surgical, single-entry updates: status, features, key-file references, updated stamp, index row, one changelog line. The counterpart maintenance skill to ship-armada — every project's CLAUDE.md points here so the manifest stays fresh even when work happens outside the orchestrator.

plugins.name: create-swe-project
plugins.description: create-swe-project (formerly slipway): scaffold a complete, working new project in ~/Dev from a project idea — interview-only LLM, script-made files. Front-loaded interview with inference (modules, RN/Expo vs native SwiftUI, macOS window vs menu-bar AND direct vs Mac-App-Store distribution, codename with 3 options, bundle prefix, GitHub org, design reference, 1Password account+vault), then scaffold.sh renders ~120 templates: pnpm/Turborepo monorepo, Next.js latest with security headers + AI SDK v7 (pinned ^7 on web AND api) + /api/health + syd1 Vercel config, full BP §9 auth (email-code sign-in, JWT + rotating refresh tokens, Resend + React Email templates, dev login gated server-side to non-prod), allowlisted admin console on a separate trust domain, APNs push over HTTP/2 (atlas pattern), optional NestJS (SWC dev/prod parity, jest+@swc/jest), SwiftUI macOS/iOS via XcodeGen with fastlane TestFlight lanes on the App Store Connect API plus sign/notarize/dmg scripts, Expo app (modules only, never EAS) with Maestro flows, Playwright e2e harness, Rust cross-OS core crate, design tokens with drift gate, Caddy + hosts + docker-compose dev env, tsgo typecheck everywhere (never tsc/ts-node), 1Password-seeded .env.local with op:// resolution, git init, install, and the gate run green — then the launch pipeline: background Dossier deep research (read in full, exported to docs/deep-research) grounding seeded feature briefs in features-to-triage, OVERVIEW.md + MARKETING-FEATURES.md with an evidence-based pricing recommendation, comprehensive mocks for every surface/flow/state via design-craft + ux-craft + mac-design-studio with a media-gen-pro icon set and 48px icon audit, a premium GSAP/three.js single-page marketing site held to a zero-slop-tells + Core-Web-Vitals bar with create-luke-content copy and interactive mock slices, and a launch-operations pack (domains, legal drafts scaffolded at /privacy and /terms, App Store kit, analytics schema with motion A/B instrumentation). Includes a referral-loop waitlist module, a region-aware Apple commercialization decision tree, and measured JS budgets from exemplar-site teardowns.

plugins.name: design-review
plugins.description: Expert design and UX review of rendered web apps, websites, app UI flows, infographics and design artifacts — the last pass before a human looks at AI-built UI. Deterministic accessibility, contrast, target-size, performance, motion and layout-integrity gates first (column alignment, shared rails, section gaps, text overlap, dead space, column/band voids, affordance, token overloading); then structural, state, craft, flow and design-system passes against real renders at multiple viewports; then severity-ranked findings with pasteable fixes, evidence, and an explicit statement of what was never checked. Use this whenever someone asks to review, audit, critique, QA, sanity-check or "give feedback on" a UI, page, screen, flow, prototype, landing page, dashboard, deck or design — or says their UI "looks AI-generated", "looks off", "feels cheap", "needs polish", "isn't accessible", or asks whether something is ready to ship. v1.4.0 closes the four blind spots a real 18-surface review found under a fully green oracle set. The runners now scroll the whole document and drain document.getAnimations() before probing and RECORD what was still running: a gate sampled mid-entrance read a #E85A2A accent as #6a2d18 and reported a surface getting worse after a fix that provably removed its failures, and lazy images probed without scrolling report five of eight as broken. probeColumnVoids() adds the column form of dead space that probeDeadSpace() is structurally blind to — a section that renders nothing still occupies its own margins — plus an unfiltered band-seam table, because a page at 92/205/229px ink-to-ink trips no single threshold and is still three-quarters dead space. probeUnconsumedTokens() catches the token declared, emitted and read by no rule: --primary-on-dark was in the contract, set by every record, present in the DOM and consumed by nothing, so a company's own 72px name sat at 2.14:1. Contrast now reports its denominator, <title> is a Level A gate (two route groups shipped without one), and the parity oracle's landmark set is per-page rather than per-site — a checks=904 diffs=0 green sat over a broken grid row on every index page of every tenant because the oracle only ever loaded /. Also: verify the computed value after a CSS fix rather than the presence of the rule, check WHAT rendered rather than THAT something rendered, and treat any first reading of a time- or scroll-dependent property as provisional.

plugins.name: braindump
plugins.description: Gets everything load-bearing out of a session and onto the page before the context holding it is thrown away. Measured across 121 real compaction events, the built-in prompt keeps 0.3% of the approaches you ruled out and 33.8% of your standing constraints; violations run 0% when a rule survives into the summary and 38% when it does not. Writes a pinned verbatim tier (constraints, corrections, dead ends and exact identifiers) ahead of the narrative, and ships a deterministic retention scorer plus a head-to-head benchmark whose baseline arm is free. Published as compaction-quality until 2026-08.

plugins.name: trawl
plugins.description: Trawl: evidence-grounded parallel divergent ideation for coding agents — cast a wide net over the idea space, then converge on something you can ship. Successor to the original adhd skill. Isolated framed branches, a frozen textbook baseline as both ban-list and boss gate, a balanced frame portfolio with fit floor and apoptosis, mechanism-level convergence with quality floors instead of 1-10 scores, tiered runs (any%/standard/100%) with an auditable receipt line. Every structural change traces to a measured result in the 2024-2026 LLM-ideation literature (see references/evidence.md).

plugins.name: create-mac-icon
plugins.description: macOS app icon creation with a measured fidelity loop: direction catalogue from a 532-icon corpus, three generation engines (hand-authored layered SVG, Arrow vector, corpus-referenced raster), a written audit.html contact sheet, and a multi-scale scoring harness that iterates the SVG master against the winning raster reference until the material matches.

plugins.name: improve-skill
plugins.description: End-to-end skill-improvement pipeline: source skill + user feedback + paid/free Dossier deep-research panel (read in full, citations verified) merged into a plan; the improved skill built as a new plugin; proven with comparative structural evals and a blind multi-family AI judge panel (CLIs + APIs, keys via 1Password); iterated on findings with blind re-judging; then the full brand treatment (user-chosen name and icon concept, mac-design-studio 3-engine icon with audit.html, composed retina banners, Luke-voice README/EVALS with succinct-then-deep comparison, root-README entry) and shipped.

plugins.name: create-skill
plugins.description: Build a brand-new skill from scratch: a broad clarifying interview that pins down trigger, output and done condition before anything is written, paid+free deep research on the skill's domain (read in full, citations verified), the build itself run through skill-creator with every structural choice traced to evidence, proof against a no-skill baseline with structural evals and a blind multi-family judge panel, then the full brand treatment and ship. The sibling of improve-skill, for when there is no predecessor to improve.

plugins.name: dossier-report
plugins.description: Turn a research question into one published, uniquely-themed HTML report page. Runs a Dossier paid+free deep-research panel, reads every member end to end rather than the merged distillation, compiles the corpus into a claim graph, then designs the page from scratch around its own subject and writes it to ~/Dev/dossier/<slug>/index.html for <slug>.fledgeling.app. Nine phases with /clarify at three gates and /trawl diverging on both research angles and visual direction, so consecutive pages do not converge on one look. Grounded in a five-backend panel over 225 sources: martini-glass structure, claim-local citations with source previews, a six-test gate before three.js is allowed, WCAG-anchored reduced-motion-first accessibility, Core Web Vitals floors, and a deterministic auditor that fails the build on a cited source that was never listed. Ships the Dossier/Margin marketing chrome as a script, and builds a per-topic page icon through create-mac-icon.

plugins.name: mac-doctor
plugins.description: Tiered macOS maintenance for a dev machine that agent CLIs, node/dev servers, Docker and Xcode have quietly filled up. Five launchd cadences (15m/1h/12h/1d/7d) whose autonomy widens as the cadence lengthens: short tiers act silently on provably-regenerable debris, long tiers propose and wait. Verification gates before every deletion, a findings ledger that makes recurring leaks visible, and measurement discipline that refuses to total a partial result.

plugins.name: discipline
plugins.description: Session-start operating defaults that cut token spend without cutting task success, tuned for Claude Opus 5 agentic coding. Ships a byte-stable 220-token block for the cached system prefix plus the measured evidence behind every clause, including a paired 106-task benchmark showing that caveman-style response compression cost 7.6 points of task score on Opus 5, with 78% of its apparent saving coming from the agent taking fewer steps rather than writing more tersely.

plugins.name: goal-harness
plugins.description: Turn a rough intent into a hardened, armed /goal run that actually keeps going. Claude Code's /goal is a session-scoped prompt Stop hook judged by Haiku on transcript text alone, with a 4,000-character condition limit, and Claude Code overrides any Stop hook after 8 consecutive blocks — which is why a goal set for hours of work stops on its own. goal-harness grounds the condition in the repo's real worklist, writes the full brief to docs/goals/goal-<slug>.md, composes a transcript-verifiable condition under the limit, preflights the six conditions that silently kill a goal (trust, disabled hooks, permission mode, block cap, non-model-invocable skills, resource contention), applies the settings changes after showing a diff, then arms a deterministic session-gated Stop guard that runs real verification commands and writes a progress ledger. Answers "has the goal been met?" and "why did you stop?" from a file instead of a guess.

plugins.name: loop-harness
plugins.description: Turn a rough intent into a hardened, armed /loop that survives being left alone. Claude Code's /loop is session-scoped: its cron expires after seven days, fires only while the session is idle, never catches up a missed fire, and since v2.1.196 silently degrades any skill Claude may not invoke on its own — /code-review and /verify among them — to plain text. loop-harness picks the right mechanism first (Monitor for event-driven, dynamic pacing for self-paced, fixed cron for true polling, or /goal when the work has an end state), writes .claude/loop.md within its 25,000-byte cap, preflights the traps, applies settings changes after showing a diff, then arms the loop with the monitor that actually wakes it, a heartbeat that catches a tick that forgot to reschedule, a renewal reminder before the seven-day expiry, and a per-tick ledger so "how's it going" is answerable without interrupting the run.

plugins.name: report
plugins.description: Turn what a Claude session already worked out into a designed, cited report: one self-contained HTML page that reads as a rich scrolling document on screen and paginates to a clean A4 PDF, plus a stripped-back one-page TLDR. Compiles the session's own evidence trail into a claim ledger before anything is designed, so every number carries a locator and anything reasoned renders visibly as inference rather than as finding. Citation markers are anchors that survive with JavaScript off, motion is stripped from the print, and the design system comes from the project's own DESIGN.md when it has one.

plugins.name: clarify
plugins.description: Decide whether to interrupt the user with a question, then ask it so it takes one click to answer. Sweeps the conversation, the repo and earlier agent output for the answer before asking anything, kills questions whose answer would not change the work, then emits a single batched AskUserQuestion in plain words — a marked recommendation carrying its reason, options described by what changes if chosen, and hard caps on length. Treats a note attached to an answer as binding rather than reading the label alone. Ships a deterministic linter for the question payload.

plugins.name: should-compact
plugins.description: Score 0-10 whether NOW is a good moment to compact a coding-agent session, and say why in one line. Scores the BOUNDARY rather than the token count: an open tool chain or a half-finished edit is a hard zero however full the window is, which is the signal that decided 98.07% of holds across 1,089 measured turns. Reads only a hot buffer of recent turns plus an append-only two-tier session log it maintains itself, so it stays cheap enough for Haiku-class models and fast enough to sit in a PreCompact hook — where it can veto an ill-timed automatic compaction, and never vetoes at the wall. Pairs with compaction-quality, handing it the log's verbatim fact tier as grounding.
